fields.label: Sync Status
fields.description: Written only by the directory sync from Glific wa_groups_phones membership activity. Not hand-maintained.

fields.label: Is Enabled
fields.description: Human-owned. Every group picker, filter dropdown and campaign target resolver includes only enabled groups by default. Never changed by the directory sync.

fields.label: Member Count
fields.description: Participant count from Glific's last directory sync (wa_groups_phones / Maytapi getGroups).

fields.label: Disabled Reason
fields.description: Why this group is disabled, e.g. school closed, duplicate group.

fields.label: School
fields.description: Optional, filterable targeting tag. A group may be shared across schools or belong to none. District/City/State below are the authoritative geo targeting fields and are never re-derived from this after creation.

fields.label: Group Language
fields.description: Overrides the contact's own language for AI reply routing when set. Also used to pick which language variant of a multi-language poll send this group receives.

fields.label: District
fields.description: Authoritative targeting field for this group. Defaults once from School at creation if blank, then owned directly here — edit this field, not School, when a group's coverage changes.

fields.label: City
fields.description: Authoritative targeting field for this group. See District.

fields.label: State
fields.description: Authoritative targeting field for this group. See District.

fields.label: Group Members
fields.description: Teachers and Students whose phone number matches a message sender seen in this group. Rebuilt by the Refresh Members action, not synced automatically on every message.
